summary: The open issues ordered in release waves by distance from tree-sitter: each wave bumps the packages it names, and the exact-pin cascade carries the bump to everything downstream. Waves 0 and 1 landed as #43-#45 and #49-#51.

waves.name: Put the commit gate back to green
waves.goal: The Apache 2.0 headers workflow passes on main and scripts/check.sh exits 0 against the current vibe-ops CLI, so the next wave commits without --no-verify.

items.note: Adds the SPDX header vibeops.config.ts shipped without in #45. Every commit on main has failed the licence workflow since, which showed as the red check on #49-#51.

scripts/check.sh on origin/main stops at 'agents-md needs a command: resolve' against the current vibe-ops CLI. The fix exists as unpushed commits on a local main checkout from another session (5a928a4, 54acb7c among five); that main has diverged from origin/main and needs a rebase before the push.

waves.name: Wave 2 — compiler to sdk
waves.goal: compiler and sdk are bumped once, with #14, #7 and #9 fixed and the AgentSession snapshot API on top of the kernel primitive.

items.note: compiler only. ADR DA00-09 rejects changing the grammar; the fix is generalising W012/W013 to guide/teach in packages/compiler/src/linter.ts:263-291, plus a lint for a duplicate interact.

compiler. unpack writes the consolidated behavior as agent.behavior but leaves the .description declaring the original name, so the next pack fails E012. DA01-02 fixed the pack side only; unpack.ts is the missing half. Before #9: both touch pack/unpack.
compiler + sdk. W016 is warn-only in packages/compiler/src/pack.ts:339-359, and packages/sdk/src/load.ts:56-58 classifies by prefix alone. Decide whether W016 becomes an error.

sdk half only. The kernel primitive landed in #51 (serialize_state / restore_state, bound to a behavior fingerprint); what remains is the snapshot and rehydrate API on AgentSession in packages/sdk/src/session.ts.

waves.name: CLI hardening — leaf, no cascade
waves.goal: Every CLI command rejects unknown options, the MCP init surface can pass force, and the tracker stops describing pkg-web/.

items.note: dot_agent_init exposes no force (apps/dot-agent-cli/src/commands/server-mcp.ts:29), so the refusal #43 added is a dead end over MCP and its error text names a CLI flag. Can run alongside any wave: cli is a leaf.

pack, unpack, run, configure and server-mcp still use the permissive loop #43 removed from init. Measured: pack --dr /tmp/x discards the typo, packs cwd and overwrites the output file with exit 0. Move them onto cli-args.ts.
project/implementation-status.md:107 describes a kernel-dsl pkg-web/ that does not exist. Docs only.

waves.name: Wave 3 — language-server debt
waves.goal: Merge-graph resolution lives in one place in the language server, with a decision recorded on multi-root workspaces.

items.note: Three call sites: features/diagnostics.js:66/86/89/109 and server.js:185-186, no cache, no multi-root. Refactor with no visible symptom; the language server is a leaf.
